free_tier.stated: 'Register for free and get 1 GB to start' and '1 GB free to start'.
free_tier.notes: The 1 GB is a registration credit, not a monthly allowance.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated: packages are capped by total volume ('up to 600 GB'), not by file size

retention.stated: not applicable: a link generator, nothing is stored

egress.terms: Time and volume sold together: a package is a period with a ceiling ('30 days up to 600 GB', '360 days up to 7200 GB'). Traffic packages are sold separately at 31 groszy per GB.
egress.price_per_tb: EUR 10.99 per 30 days up to 600 GB (1.83 groszy/GB); EUR 76.99 per 360 days up to 7200 GB (1.07 groszy/GB)

interface_detail: Web application plus 'Apps' for Smart TV; the site also runs a companion 'generator premium - lista hostingów' page. No API is documented.
tooling: Browser, Smart TV apps and a host-list generator page; no JDownloader plugin or CLI is named on the reachable pages.
chaining: A 30-day 600 GB package covers a single heavy week and then stops, so it composes with a monthly host subscription only as an overflow: a user buys the Polish package for one burst and keeps the always-on account elsewhere.

limits.value: 30-day package ceiling 600 GB; 360-day package ceiling 7200 GB

limits_note: The package ceiling is the product itself; there is no separate fair-use paragraph and no concurrency figure on the pricing page.
binding_note: two consecutive packages would be needed and the site does not say whether they queue.

identity_cost.detail: Registration form on the home page asks for a login, an email and a password, and a terms checkbox. No card at registration; the 1 GB credit is granted on signup.

reliability_note: Operating since 2009 and reporting 818,728 users, with a Trustpilot profile linked from the home page; the volume ceiling is what stops a heavy month, not speed.
confidence_note: Vendor pages read today give the free credit, the host count (64), the operating history and every package price with its ceiling. What would raise it: a package bought and 600 GB pulled, which would also test whether the ceiling is enforced per calendar or per rolling 30 days.

evidence.proved: '1 GB free to start', 'We support 64 hostings', 'continuously since 2009', 'We have been trusted by 818728 users'

the package ladder: 7 days up to 140 GB EUR 5.49; 30 days up to 600 GB EUR 10.99; 90 days up to 1800 GB EUR 27.49; 180 days up to 3600 GB EUR 43.99; 360 days up to 7200 GB EUR 76.99; traffic packages from 31 groszy/GB

price_per_tb_month: EUR 10.99 per 600 GB / 30 days (EUR 18.32/TB); EUR 76.99 per 7200 GB / 360 days (EUR 10.69/TB)
notes: The Polish market is priced per gigabyte, not per month, and Rapideo is the only one of the five that also sells a timed package. At 1 TiB/month the 30-day ceiling falls short by 40 percent; the 360-day package reaches EUR 10.69/TB, which is under HIGHWAY's EUR 16/TB and over AllDebrid's effective zero. Two currencies in one record: the vendor quotes EUR on the Polish page, so no conversion is needed.
